primaryCue.zh: 脚跟踩稳，膝盖对准脚尖
primaryCue.en: Heels down, knees track over the toes

primaryCue.zh: 左右交替侧迈步，双臂上举，不跳起
primaryCue.en: Step out to alternate sides and raise both arms without jumping

phase.start.en: Step out and raise your arms

phase.end.en: Step in and lower your arms

primaryCue.zh: 用腹部卷起上背，双手沿大腿向前伸
primaryCue.en: Use your abs to curl your upper back up and reach your hands along your thighs

primaryCue.zh: 手脚轻轻抬起，颈部自然延长，不追求高度
primaryCue.en: Lift your arms and legs gently, keep your neck long, and avoid forcing height

primaryCue.zh: 微屈膝，臀部向后推，背部保持稳定
primaryCue.en: Soften your knees, push your hips back, and keep your back steady

primaryCue.zh: 脚跟踩稳，缓慢转动胸廓，骨盆保持稳定
primaryCue.en: Keep your heels down and turn your rib cage slowly while your pelvis stays steady

primaryCue.zh: 手脚移向同侧，肩和骨盆保持贴垫，拉长体侧
primaryCue.en: Move your arms and legs to one side, keeping your shoulders and pelvis on the mat to lengthen your side

phase.start.en: Move your arms and legs to one side

primaryCue.zh: 右手举过头，身体慢慢向左侧弯，不前倾
primaryCue.en: Reach your right arm overhead and bend slowly to the left without leaning forwards
